capabilities: Sort folders and files together in a single list
Sort by modified time, created time, or name
Choose how a folder gets its timestamp (newest descendant, newest direct child, or filesystem)
Toggle mixing on and off via commands or settings
extras: Incompatible with other plugins that patch the same File Explorer sorting method (Custom File Explorer sorting, Flexplorer, Folder Sort Rules); requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
intentEvidence: Core File Explorer always lists every folder, then every file. This plugin removes that split.
motivation: The README's Why section says the split between folders and files is the reason: the author wanted recently edited notes and folders to sit next to each other.
problem: The core File Explorer always groups all folders before all files, so a recently edited note can appear below an older folder regardless of time order.

relations.evidence: Do not enable this together with Custom File Explorer sorting, Flexplorer, or Folder Sort Rules.
They patch the same File Explorer method; last one wins.
No YAML. No sortspec. No per-folder index notes. One global setting.

summary: File Explorer sorter that interleaves folders and files in one list by modified time, created time, or name instead of listing folders first.
